fields.Intake — Published:
30 seats each PM, HHM and International Trade Management (90 aggregate; 2025–26 prospectus)
Published numeric intake: 90
fields.Fee Scope: Published programme fee; inspect text for exclusions/refundable items
fields.Accepted Exams: CUET score / qualifying-degree merit / GD-PI as stated in the 2026–27 prospectus mirror; programme-specific implementation requires the university notice.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: No verified CAT-specific cutoff. The 2026–27 prospectus mirror lists specialist SAHSM selection through CUET/degree merit/GD-PI as notified; confirm the programme-specific notice.
fields.Eligibility: 2026–27 prospectus mirror: Pharmaceutical Management requires pharmacy/AYUSH pharmacy or specified life-science degree; International Trade accepts listed commerce/economics/management/science/pharmacy/information-management degrees; Healthcare/Hospital accepts listed health-profession degrees. Minimum 55%; 5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD. Age over 20 by 31 December 2026. Confirm exact degree eligibility with university because the current official PDF is unreachable.
fields.Selection Process: 2026–27 prospectus mirror lists CUET score, qualifying-degree merit and GD/PI for SAHSM postgraduate selection, followed by university merit list. Exact weighting not stated; verify current admission notice.
fields.Highest CTC — Published: ₹8.5 LPA university-wide 2023–24; not an MBA-only maximum
fields.Placement — Published: 200+ students placed university-wide 2023–24; MBA denominator not disclosed
fields.Placement Scope: University-wide average ₹5 lakh and highest ₹8.5 lakh for 2023–24; separate MBA outcomes not established.
fields.Top Recruiters: WNS; IQVIA; Dr Reddy’s; Abbott; Cipla; Novartis; ZS; Eli L illy; Mankind; Fortis; TCS (university pool)
fields.Official Role Examples: Published alumni testimonials include Analyst at IQVIA, Brand Executive at Pulse Pharmaceuticals and business/healthcare roles; historical examples in the 2025–27 recruiting brochure, not a current cohort salary report.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Healthcare Consultant; Hospital Operations; Pharma Product/Market Access; Health Analytics
fields.Notes: The 2026-27 official prospectus confirms multiple specialist MBA routes at DPSRU.
